import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by passenger class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot = survival_pivot.reindex(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Survival count by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival = embark_survival.reindex(['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Queenstown'])
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, color=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'], width=0.6)
ax3.set_title('Passenger Count by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=30, ha='right')
ax3.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'], title='Status', loc='upper right')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Fare distribution vs survival (violin plot)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df_fare = df[df['fare'] < 300].copy()  # Remove extreme outliers for better visualization
df_fare['Survival'] = df_fare['survived'].map({0: 'Did not survive', 1: 'Survived'})
sns.violinplot(data=df_fare, x='Survival', y='fare', ax=ax4, palette=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'])
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Survival Status', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
